denial_reason: The records submitted do not document a prior lumbar spine X-ray.

docs.author: Dr. Samuel Oyelaran
sentences: Patient is a 69-year-old woman with low back pain for about ten days.
Denies bowel or bladder changes, fever, weight loss or any history of cancer.
Sleeps about six hours a night.
Symptoms began ten days ago after lifting a heavy box.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
docs.title: Orthopedic clinic visit note

payer_letter: Harborline Medicare Advantage has reviewed claim A-1030 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of a prior lumbar spine X-ray together with at least six weeks of conservative treatment, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document a prior lumbar spine X-ray. You may request reconsideration within 60 days of this notice.
